name: Service to the Horde
label: Quest
description: The jeweled pendant now sits with Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar, delivered after Report to Zor, and Zor has one more word for you.
intro: The jeweled pendant now sits with Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar, delivered after Report to Zor, and Zor has one more word for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It will take time for our scholars to study the pendant you brought us. But for your service to the Horde I would like to offer you a small token.
Thank you, friend. Your acts bring honor to you, and to us.
